उभयानुमत mfn. agreed to or accepted on both sides.

उभयीय mfn. belonging to both.

m: उभय mf(ई)n. (only sg. and pl.; according to Hara-datta also du. See Siddh. vol. i, p. 98) both, of both kinds, in both ways, in both manners, RV.; AV.; TS.; ŚBr.; AitĀr.; Mn. &c.
a: उभय — pron. a. (यी f.) (Though dual in sense, it is used in the singular and plural only; according to some grammarians in the dual also) Both (of persons or things); उभयमप्यपरितोषं समर्थये Ś. 7; उभयमानशिरे वसुधाधिपाः R. 9. 9; उभयीं सिद्धिमुभाववापतुः 8. 23, 17. 38; Amaru. 60; Ku. 7. 78; Ms. 2. 55, 4. 224; 9. 34. --Comp. --अर्थं ind. for a double object (for earthly prosperity and heavenly happiness also). --आत्मक a. belonging to both. --चर a. living in water and on land or in the air, amphibious. --(रः) a class of birds who live both on land and in the air. --द्युः ind. {1} on both days. {2} the day past and to come. --भागहर a. {1} applicable to two objects. {2} taking two shares. --(रं) a medicine that acts in two ways (both as an emetic and a purgative). --विद्या two fold sciences; i. e. religious knowledge and knowledge about worldly affairs. --विध a. of both kinds. --वेतन a. receiving wages from both (parties), serving two masters, treacherous, perfidious; उभयवेतनो भूत्वा Pt. 1; Śi. 2. 113. --व्यंजन a. having the marks of both sexes. --संभवः a dilemma.

m: उभय—भाग mfn. having part in both (night and day)
उभय—भाग—हर mfn. taking two shares or parts
applicable to two purposes
उभय—भाग—हर n. a medicine that acts in two ways (as an emetic and a purge).
उभय—भाज् mfn. acting in two ways (as a medicine, cf. the last), Car.
उभय—˚ंकर mfn. doing or effecting both, RV. viii, 1, 2.
उभय—शिरस् mfn. ‘having a head towards both ways’ or ‘two-headed’, a pregnant female (cf. -मुख above), Hcat.
उभयथा ind. in both ways, in both cases, ŚBr.; Pāṇ.; Vikr. &c.
a: उभयथा — ind. 1 In both ways; उभयथापि घटते V. 3. --2 In both cases.

m: उभय—चारिन् mfn. going or moving in both (night and day), VarBṛS.
उभय—च्छन्ना f. (in rhet.) a kind of enigma, Kāvyād.

उभय—˚वंश्य mfn. (fr. उभय-वंश), belonging to both families or lineages, BhP.
उभय—वर्तनिन् mfn. having both wheels (or two wheels), TāṇḍBr.
उभय—वत् mfn. furnished with or containing both, VPrāt.; Nir.

v: pu॰ uBayoH Bedye syAmini ca vetanaM yasya ayac । dUtaBede yo hi svAmisakASAt pracCannAM BftiM gfhItvA tadBedyaSatrusakASe tadIyadAsatvenAtmAnaM KyApayitvA tatsakASAt BftiM gfhRannapi pUrvasvAminogfhotaBftinizkrayArTamuttarasya sacivAdiBedaM janayati sa uBayavetana ityucyate । “ajYAtadozErdozajYEruddUzyoBayavEtanEH । BedyAH SatroraBivyaktaSAsanEH sAmavAyikAH” mAGaH । tAdfSadUtASca mudrArAkzase cARaKyaprezitA vahavo varRitAH te ca malayaketoH praDAnasacivAdIn rAkzasAdIn tato viBidya cARakyakAryyaM sADitavantaH tacca tata evAvaseya vistaraBayAnnoktam ।
m: उभय—वेतन mfn. ‘receiving wages from both’, a spy who seemingly enters the enemy's service, Śiś. ii, 113
a perfidious or treacherous servant, Pañcat.
उभय—वेतन—त्व n. the state of receiving wages from both, Bālar.
उभय—विध mfn. of two kinds or forms, Nir. Comm. on Nyāyam.
उभय—विद्या f. the twofold science (i.e. religious knowledge and acquaintance with worldly affairs, MW.)
उभय—विपुला f. N. of a metre.
उभय—व्यञ्जन n. having the marks of both sexes, a hermaphrodite, L.

s: [s] vya (uBayorahnoH । sadyaHparuditi uBayAdedyus nipAtitaH .) uBayadinam । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, EtareyabrAhmaRe । 5 । 29 ॥ “agnihotramuBayedyurahUyata” ॥)

m: उभये-द्युस् ind. on both days, on two subsequent days, AitBr. v, 29, 3; Pāṇ. v, 3, 22.
a: उभये(य)द्युस् — ind. 1 On both days. --2 On two subsequent days.
